plan.note: Shared host; initial GC after import/fixture setup, no warmup. Active wall/CPU and whole-process peak RSS are distinct. Build outside worker timing.

measurementSemantics.explicitGC: One globalThis.gc() in each fresh worker after imports and fixture/oracle setup, before timing. No manual GC inside timed work. Natural GC included. No new heap-allocation measurements.
measurementSemantics.wallAndCPU: Outer sample fields time run() after setup. CPU is process user+system; helper loops include assertions. CSV outer includes original monitor setup/teardown; outcome.active excludes original two 20ms waits. CSV active CPU includes request assertions; whole-worker startup/build CPU is not included.
measurementSemantics.peakRSS: Linux VmHWM for the whole worker through the end of measured work; includes imports, setup, oracle strings and GC. No subtraction. It is not active-only/retained heap or allocated bytes.
measurementSemantics.host: Linux x64 shared AMD RYZEN AI MAX+395; per-sample UTC/load/free memory retained. Root deferred heavy tests; UX reviewer reported idle; context owner may have small tests. Other host activity not controlled.
measurementSemantics.build: Production Vite build before timing. Before runtime uses recovered a280 build; after runtime build records full source and module manifest. Pure helpers use same Node stripTypeScriptTypes transform for before and after.
measurementSemantics.ordering: Within each workload pair1 before/after, pair2 after/before, pair3 before/after; workloads pagination, csv, context-ordinary, context-escaped.
